items.title: 10.18 Variation of E value with ion concentration (ion concentration badalne se E ka badalna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.18 with Table 10.1, printed page 234.

blocks.text: Equilibrium ki position concentration, temperature aur pressure badalne se badal jati hai. Agar kisi half-cell X ki concentration ya temperature badlein to us ka electrode potential bhi badal jata hai. In non-standard (jo standard nahi) conditions mein electrode potential ke liye symbol E (bina °) istemal hota hai. Metal/metal ion equilibrium ki misal lete hain:

blocks.caption: Table 10.1 Ion concentration ke saath potential ki tabdeeli

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne yahan Zn²⁺ + e⁻ → Zn chhapa hai; Zn²⁺ ko Zn banne ke liye do electrons chahiye: Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Zn.

items: Agar [Zn²⁺] 1.00 mol dm⁻³ se zyada ho to E kam negative / zyada positive ho jata hai (maslan −0.61 V).
Agar [Zn²⁺] 1.00 mol dm⁻³ se kam ho to E zyada negative / kam positive ho jata hai (maslan −0.80 V).

blocks.text: Le-Chatelier ka principle redox equilibria par bhi lagta hai. Agar equation ke left side ki species ki concentration barhayen to equilibrium right side shift hota hai, aur E zyada positive / kam negative ho jata hai. Ions ki concentration badalne ka E par asar Table 10.1 mein hai. Agar half-cell mein do different (alag alag) ions hon to dono ka khayal rakhna parta hai; misal ke taur par Fe³⁺ aur Fe²⁺ ka equilibrium:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “change in contraction of ions” chhapa hai; sahi lafz “concentration” hai.

blocks.text_alt: Fe³⁺ + e⁻ → Fe²⁺   E° = +0.77 V (Fe³⁺ 1.00 mol dm⁻³, Fe²⁺ 1.00 mol dm⁻³)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Fe³⁺ + e⁻ ⇌ Fe²⁺ mein Fe³⁺ left side hai: Fe³⁺ barhayen (ya Fe²⁺ ghatayen) to equilibrium right jata hai aur E +0.77 se barh kar +0.85 V ho jata hai. Fe³⁺ ghatayen (ya Fe²⁺ barhayen) to E ghat kar +0.70 V ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Half-reaction ke electrode potential par ion concentration badalne ka kya asar hai?
blocks.explanation: Left side ki (oxidized) species ki concentration barhane se equilibrium right shift hota hai aur E zyada positive hota hai; right side ki (reduced) species barhane ya left wali ghatane se E zyada negative hota hai. Sirf 1.00 mol dm⁻³ par E = E° hota hai.

items: [Zn²⁺] zyada: E kam negative (−0.61 V); [Zn²⁺] kam: E zyada negative (−0.80 V).
Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ (+0.77 V): Fe³⁺ zyada ya Fe²⁺ kam → +0.85 V; ulta → +0.70 V.
